run_evaluate_dpll: run the DPLL solver on a pickled 3SAT dataset and print correctness metrics
run_evaluate_dpll_with_custom_path: run evaluate_dpll with a custom pickle file path to evaluate 3SAT formulas
test_evaluate_dpll: test the evaluate_dpll function against a known 3SAT dataset and verify decision counts
refactor_evaluate_dpll: refactor evaluate_dpll to accept the dataset path as a command-line argument instead of hardcoding it
